face.note: q34 forced (yaw 17, judged as 3/4 by the critics); rounded open eyes, calm mouth

patches.note: painted form on skin below the chin: one clean core-shadow band per limb, S4 occlusion edge, one S1 highlight (re-banded from the render normals with the key light of this still) [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
despeckle the render's dark I4 islands (<= 2 px) in the hair mass [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
crown: soften the dark seam and drop the render's straight I0 bar (the ring is redrawn as arcs) [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
head: the render's loose azure hairtip specks on the crown (critic: 'noise') become hair tones [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
angel ring: short I0 arcs with I1 ends that follow the skull outline, broken at every clump [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
clump separators (I3, one step darker than the I2 shadow) from the ring into the bang notches [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
azure tips (DESIGN s6): the last 3 px of every free hair end, A2 -> A3 -> A4 [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
sidelock gold cross clasp (DESIGN s6), 2x2 at collarbone height on the near lock [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
crease lines at the fold roots (one step darker than the cloth shadow) [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
blade glint: A5 core with A4 arms (the one specular star on the weapon) [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]
glaive hand: back of the hand to camera round the vertical haft, lit knuckles, thumb lobe under, wrist into the cuff [mapped from the 144 layer through the root anchor, x0.889]

rim.note: world rim from upper back (lab rimDir); DESIGN.md s9 lit outline
